Yes. I found several Toronto/GTA providers that look relevant, but they split into performance/funnel shops and creative/short-form specialists.

Best matches for your exact need

PPC Guru — best all-in-one fit

Toronto-based.

Builds landing pages + runs Meta/Instagram/TikTok ads and CRO.

More performance-oriented than a traditional creative agency, so a good fit if the goal is leads/sales rather than just nice-looking content.

ORCAFY Marketing Agency — strong for local/service businesses

Etobicoke-based.

Focuses heavily on lead generation for service businesses and offers vertical-video/creative work alongside paid advertising. 
Orcafy

Worth considering for businesses like contractors, clinics, restaurants, realtors, etc.

Social Signals Marketing — best if short-form content is a big priority

Toronto-based.

Explicitly offers short-form video for TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts and Facebook, plus paid ads and conversion-focused web design.

This is probably one of the closer matches if you want someone to actually make the videos, not merely manage ad campaigns.

Viva Media — strongest video-production option

Etobicoke/Toronto.

Produces Reels, TikToks, Shorts, UGC-style content and paid-social creative.

Better choice if production quality and a library of creative assets matter.

Webblyfy — interesting performance-focused option

Toronto-headquartered.

Explicitly combines Meta ads, ad creative and dedicated landing pages in-house. 
Webblyfy
+1

Their positioning is particularly geared toward businesses wanting leads rather than vanity metrics.

myBloom — small-business-friendly all-in-one

Toronto marketing/web-development firm aimed specifically at small businesses.

Runs Meta ads, creates websites, social content and funnels; its Meta management starts at $700 CAD/month according to its published pricing. 
Bloom Headquarters
+1

A couple of specialists worth knowing

Brand Nav — particularly interesting for the landing-page side. They advertise conversion-focused landing pages for Google/Meta traffic starting at $2,000 flat, with tracking and CRM integration. 
BrandNav

The Iconic Management — unusually close to the short-form ads → landing page → Meta funnel model. Their package includes professionally produced short videos specifically designed as Instagram/Facebook ads, plus custom landing pages and campaign management. 
The Iconic Management

Encipher — Toronto PPC/social agency that also explicitly offers short-form video and paid social. 
Encipher

My shortlist

If I were hiring for a Toronto small business and wanted someone to handle the whole thing, I'd start with:

Provider	Landing pages	Short-form video	Paid ads	Small-business fit
PPC Guru	★★★	★★	★★★	★★★
Social Signals	★★★	★★★	★★★	★★★
ORCAFY	★★	★★★	★★★	★★★
Webblyfy	★★★	★★	★★★	★★★
myBloom	★★★	★★	★★★	★★★
Viva Media	★	★★★	★★	★★
Iconic Management	★★★	★★★	★★★	★★

One thing I'd watch: don't hire a generic web designer to build the landing page and then separately hire a social-media person to make videos. For paid acquisition, it's much better when the hook in the video → ad copy → landing-page headline → offer → conversion tracking are designed as one funnel.

If you tell me what kind of small business you have and roughly what you'd like to spend per month (e.g. $1k, $3k, $5k+), I can narrow this to 3 Toronto providers that are actually appropriate for your budget, including their pricing and examples of their work.

ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.
